g.text: Decoupled clipping & dynamic sampling for long-CoT RL
Correctness + soft length penalty → shaped reward
Normalize rewards within each retained group
One response advantage → all its valid tokens
Old policy supplies the ratio; no reference KL.
Collect until N prompt groups are retained
Dashed blue: collect more / refresh snapshot
Clip shapes incentives, not a hard update bound.
Mask m: 1 for valid tokens; 0 for truncation.
No penalty → linear ramp to −1 → cap
Schematic: four illustrative completions; paper uses G = 16. Correctness rewards: +1 / −1.
